C-RELEASE-RC-CHANNEL.IntentSummary: Make the npm publication channel explicit end to end: publish.yml gains a validated channel input and passes --tag on npm publish, release-bump derives the channel from the bumped version and marks rc GitHub Releases as pre-release, and the upgrade command resolves --rc (with --allow-prerelease as an equivalent alias) from the npm rc dist-tag with clear no-candidate degradation, leaving the default latest upgrade path unchanged, with README and GRACE projections synchronized.

T-001.Title: Resolve rc upgrades from the npm dist-tag endpoint with degradation.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: upgrade.ts adds a dist-tags fetch (GET /@scope%2Fname entry point or /-/package/.../dist-tags) returning the rc tag version, exported as fetchRcDistTagVersion with the same fail-soft null semantics as the existing latest fetch.

The command gains a --rc boolean flag; --rc and --allow-prerelease both resolve the target from the rc dist-tag, replacing the maximum-of-all-versions resolution, and remain injectable through the existing dependency overrides.
When the rc dist-tag is absent or unresolvable, the command prints a clear no release candidate message, exits zero, installs nothing, and runs no sync or completion subprocess.
Default resolution without flags still reads the latest dist-tag only, and the existing already-latest short-circuit and semver ordering (including pre-release ordering) are unchanged.

runUpgradeFlow status handling gains the no-candidate outcome without disturbing the existing statuses, and injectable tests cover flag equivalence, absent-tag degradation, default unchanged behavior, and ordering against pre-release current versions.
MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, block anchors, and CHANGE_SUMMARY stay accurate in both edited files.

T-002.Title: Derive the release channel in release-bump and mark rc releases as pre-release.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: release-bump.ts exports deriveReleaseChannel(version) returning rc for versions whose pre-release identifiers start with rc and latest otherwise, deterministic and pure.

parseNpmVersionArgs or a sibling parser accepts an optional explicit --channel argument, validates it against latest and rc, and rejects a value contradicting the version-derived channel with a clear error naming both.
ReleaseWorkflowDispatchInput gains the channel field, dispatchVerifiedPublishWorkflow passes it as a -f channel= input, and the retry hint message includes the channel field.
PublishedReleaseFinalizationInput gains the channel, and gh release create for rc channels adds --prerelease while latest stays unchanged.
main() derives the channel from the bumped version, and console output states the derived channel before dispatch.

Deterministic tests cover rc and latest derivation across explicit and keyword bumps, channel contradiction rejection, dispatch argument assembly including the channel input, and --prerelease flag presence per channel.
MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, and CHANGE_SUMMARY stay accurate in both edited files.

T-003.Title: Publish through a validated channel input in publish.yml.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: publish.yml gains a required channel string input with a latest default and the workflow validates the value against latest and rc before publication, failing closed on anything else.
The publish step runs npm publish --access public --provenance --tag "$CHANNEL" (or equivalent quoting) so the latest dist-tag can never move onto a pre-release publication.
The already-published recovery branch keeps skipping npm publish and still succeeds, independent of channel.
No other workflow gates, permissions, or exact-SHA verification steps change.
Workflow structure remains valid YAML with the concurrency group still keyed by version.

T-004.Title: Document the rc workflow and upgrade flags.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: README documents the release-candidate workflow: prerelease bumps with --preid rc publish to the rc dist-tag, default upgrades stay on latest, and a final stable bump of the same version publishes to latest.
README documents vvoc upgrade --rc including --allow-prerelease equivalence and the no-candidate message, plus manual npm install @rc for plugin consumers.
Every documented command, flag, and default is checked against current source and the workflow file.

T-005.Title: Run the integrated regression gate and resolve only in-scope failures.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All upgrade and release-bump tests pass together with the full repository suite and no live npm, gh, or git mutations occur in tests.
bun run check passes with no regressions outside the observed write scope.

T-006.Title: Synchronize GRACE projections and run final gates.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: M-CLI-UPGRADE and M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION descriptions reflect dist-tag based rc resolution and channel-aware publication, and their graph entries stay otherwise unchanged.
V-M-CLI-UPGRADE and V-M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION gain the new deterministic scenarios and commands while preserving existing ones.
bun run build, bun run pack:check, and bun run release:check pass, and git diff contains only approved files with no secrets or generated dist content.
GRACE lint and status report no errors attributable to C-RELEASE-RC-CHANNEL.
